checks.name: save during initial decode preserves the loaded PNG
exit before decode preserves PNG and rejects the late callback
successful restore enables drawing and later saves the actual new stroke
early drawing does not replace the picture still being loaded
decode error keeps the original and offers explicit new-paper recovery
destroy and return with the same canvas cannot revive the old callback
new restore owns saving while older load and error callbacks are ignored
new paper during loading can undo back to the original canonical PNG
empty restore cancels pending work and makes an intentional blank writable
canvas draw failure protects the source just like decode failure
template and mode metadata can still save while free drawing restores
a first visit without a saved drawing stays immediately drawable

limits: Node callback simulation with distinct PNG markers; no actual PNG decoding or browser pixel comparison.
Loading touch is intentionally deferred until restore completes; explicit new paper recovers from a decode failure.
